{{Quote|A woman here in Mos Espa bought the legs. Her name was ahh... Syndil, maybe. Anyway she has her own problem she would like help with, and will be contacting you soon.|[[Watto/Legends|Watto]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LW" />}}
'''Syndil Na'Marr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|woman]] who resided on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:LW" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Syndil Na'Marr bought the legs from a [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 unit]] to the [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]]. However, the droid was wanted by both [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Arlan Barrezz|Barrezz]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Carh'la Bastra|Bastra]] and an Imperial Captain soon confiscated the legs. One of Syndil's friend, a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] pilot, later went after the Imperial Captain and managed to ambush and destroy the Captain's [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] in the [[Mospic High Range/Legends|Mospic High Range]]. However, the pilot was downed and unable to contact Syndil Na'Marr. When a spacer looking for the droid legs approached Syndil, she agreed to give them if the spacer was able to rescue her missing pilot friend. The spacer thus went to the mountains, found the downed pilot and finally recovered the droid legs from hostile [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] in the area.<ref name="SWG:LW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Syndil Na'Marr was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Syndil Na'Marr was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> In the first version of the quest "[[W:c:swg:Leg Work|Leg Work]]," players had to visit Na'Marr and discuss her. This quest was shortened upon the release of "[[W:c:swg:Publish 27 Notes for February 15th, 2006|Publish 27]]" and the woman directly contacted the player by comm in the new version of the quest. In consequence, Syndil Na'Marr's character was removed from the game.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 27 is now live!">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=66900&month=022006|text=Publish 27 is now live!}}</ref>
